kandoInfo.heading: Kando Martial Arts Knox
description: Kando Martial Arts was founded in 1997 by Chief Instructor Shihan Paul Veldman, a highly respected martial arts teacher with decades of experience.

Shihan Paul holds a 6th Degree Black Belt in Karate and began training at age 13 in San Chi Kai Freestyle Karate. He later specialised in traditional Shukokai Karate at Sendai Karate under Sensei Kurt Klimkait, earning his Black Belt in 1995.
Sensei Andy began his karate journey with Kando at age 12 after experiencing bullying. Over 15 years of training, karate helped him build confidence, resilience, and leadership skills.

With over 10 years of teaching experience, Sensei Andy played a key role in growing Kando Rowville into the second-largest Kando club. He is now established his own Kando MartialArts club in Knox, continuing Kando’s tradition of quality karate instruction for the Wantirna area.
Kando Martial Arts Knox is a proud member of the Kando Martial Arts family, and is committed to providing the highest quality karate instruction for the Wantirna area.

getToKando.heading: Getting to Kando Martial Arts Knox from Wantirna
description: Wantirna families looking for authentic karate instruction often choose Kando Martial Arts Knox because we focus on building strong foundations in both technique and character. Our Boronia location serves Wantirna residents who appreciate our emphasis on traditional martial arts values while providing a supportive, family-oriented training environment.

The journey from Wantirna to our Boronia dojo typically takes around 10 to 15 minutes by car. Take Mountain Highway heading west toward Boronia, then turn onto Boronia Road. From Boronia Road, turn into Lewis Road, followed by a turn into Wadhurst Drive. Our facility is located at Unit 2/5 Wadhurst Drive, Boronia.

Wantirna students benefit from our accessible location, making it easy to maintain regular training schedules. The short commute means families can consistently attend classes, participate in gradings, and engage with our martial arts community without the challenge of long travel times, helping students progress steadily through their karate journey. This consistent progress helps Wantirna students build confidence and achieve their martial arts goals, creating a foundation for success both on and off the mat.
